page-cream.$description: Page Cream — Page background, large section surfaces — the warm paper tone that sets the entire mood

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Card surfaces, elevated panels, input fills, inverse text on dark buttons

charcoal-ink.$description: Charcoal Ink — Supporting neutral for secondary UI, dividers, and muted labels. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary text, muted UI labels, icon strokes, nav links

slate.$description: Slate — Tertiary text, footer body, helper copy, low-emphasis borders

stone.$description: Stone — Disabled states, lowest-emphasis text, decorative dividers

driftwood.$description: Driftwood — Hairline list dividers, subtle structural separators

linen.$description: Linen — Card borders, input borders, subtle elevation shadows — the neutral that separates surfaces on cream

ash.$description: Ash — Input border, focused field rings, checkbox borders

soft-black.$description: Soft Black — True black for maximum-contrast dark buttons and bold display text

brand-orange.$description: Brand Orange — Headspace logo mark — the single warm dot that anchors the brand identity across all surfaces

mindful-blue.$description: Mindful Blue — Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

sunbeam-yellow.$description: Sunbeam Yellow — Headspace signature brand yellow — top banner backgrounds, feature card highlights, optimistic punctuation

deep-indigo.$description: Deep Indigo — Contemplative illustration fills, meditation-related visual moments — the serious counterpart to the cheerful yellow

twilight-violet.$description: Twilight Violet — Deep illustration fills paired with Deep Indigo, gradient companion, night-mode meditation contexts

plum.$description: Plum — Mid-tone violet for illustration gradients and decorative fills

mauve.$description: Mauve — Lighter violet in illustration gradients — soft, warm purple

celeste.$description: Celeste — Bright sky blue used in category icons and decorative illustration accents

headspace-apercu.$description: Single-family system used for everything from body copy to display headlines. Weights are 400 (body), 500 (subheadings, nav), 700 (headings, buttons). The custom geometric forms give a friendly-but-precise feel; tight tracking on display sizes sculpts the headlines into confident shapes rather than defaulting to bold shouts.
